headline: How long will my prayers for money keep going unanswered?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing marked them apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Four things laid out, none of them put back.
You asked how much longer your prayers will go unanswered. What catches me is that all four sit within reach.
And yet it hasn't landed. And what you want from me is a number.
Something turns up just as it would come through. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs told you nothing, and yours was held by a single rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest of him hangs loose.
You asked how much longer your prayers will go unanswered. This card makes me look at one rope taking all the weight.
Still, it hasn't come through. And the quiet has gone on.
The hold is steady — it doesn't tighten and it doesn't ease. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. It's gold, without a cloud in it.
You asked how much longer your prayers will go unanswered. This card brings me to a gold sky with no cloud in it.
But it hasn't landed. And you're the one still asking how long.
Something sits right where it would arrive. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
